brandPositioningSummary: Westin is an owner-facing premium wellness-led full-service Westin brand within Marriott International. Underwrite the asset against this brand's guest promise, product scope, and operating complexity rather than sibling brands or corporate platform averages.
audienceSummary: Westin targets guests aligned with Experience-Oriented, Bleisure, Leisure. Evaluate demand behavior in each target market rather than generic chain-loyalty averages or parent-platform assumptions.
ownerFitSummary: Westin should be chosen when the asset can deliver this positioning more credibly than Sheraton, Marriott Hotels, W Hotels, JW Marriott, and Renaissance. Assess whether demand mix, product scope, and operating complexity favor Westin over adjacent Marriott alternatives in the same tier and geography.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Premium Wellness Urban Conversion
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Westin fits premium urban assets where wellness programming, rooms product, and calm public space can support higher-intent bleisure demand without forcing a W lifestyle or JW luxury capital stack.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Wellness-Led Resort Repositioning
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Resort sites create Westin value when spa, fitness, and restorative guestroom design are capitalized as demand drivers—owners must price wellness operating intensity honestly against Sheraton or Marriott Hotels alternatives.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Business-Leisure Premium Mixed Use
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Mixed business and leisure corridors suit Westin when guests pay for wellbeing and polished full-service delivery. Affiliation helps when the plant already supports premium standards rather than midscale shortcuts.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Standards-Protective Reflag
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Reflags succeed when Heavenly-adjacent product cues and service culture stay brand-legible after cutover. Value fades if the PIP leaves a generic upscale box that guests cannot distinguish from sibling full-service brands.

scenarios.title: Premium Wellness Full-Service Positioning
scenarios.summary: Westin creates owner value when wellness is an underwritable product system—rooms, fitness, F&B cues, and service—not filler language. Diligence capital and staffing for premium full-service delivery, and separate the file from W Hotels lifestyle luxury and JW Marriott. CALA examples such as The Westin Resort & Spa, Cancun help owners see regional premium leisure execution.

scenarios.title: Urban And Resort Premium Demand Capture
scenarios.summary: Owner value rises in urban gateways and resort nodes where bleisure and leisure guests seek restorative stays. Underwrite public-space calm, fitness access, and rooms consistency before modeling affiliation lift. Compare Sheraton and Marriott Hotels when meetings-led full-service is the stronger asset story. Keep Westin product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the premium wellness-led full-service Westin brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

scenarios.title: Bonvoy Reach With Wellness Discipline
scenarios.summary: Marriott Bonvoy strengthens distribution only when Westin product discipline holds after opening. Sequence PIP, systems, and training so wellness cues survive ramp-up. Avoid borrowing W or JW proof points into Westin diligence. Keep Westin product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the premium wellness-led full-service Westin brand stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.
